records.primary_classification: STK11功能表型与免疫治疗分层
records.boundary: Exploratory trial biomarker subsets, not a prospectively validated treatment-selection assay. Only OAK has tissue STK11 data; RAS84 is a transcriptomic surrogate, not measured KRAS genotype. Treatment interactions differ by trial/endpoint (OAK OS P=.27; ORIENT-11 OS/PFS P=.15). Def-group CD8 OS trends are nonsignificant; bulk inference does not prove T-cell dysfunction or STING causality. Figure1 says eight common genes but lists seven; cohort-specific feature availability and quartile thresholds limit deployment. Separate supplements not supplied. OAK tissue genomic labels are available, but their sequencing-platform resolution is not verified from the supplied main text; no targeted-DNA assay tag is assigned.

records.title: LKB1 dictates sensitivity to immunotherapy through Skp2-mediated ubiquitination of PD-L1 protein in non-small cell lung cancer
records.primary_classification: LKB1-AMPK-Skp2调节PD-L1稳定性及抗PD-L1负向联合结果
records.boundary: No STK11-mutation-specific clinical predictive result: the checkpoint-treated n=40 cohort was entirely STK11-WT, and the separate n=40 surgical expression/genotype specimens are not interchangeable with it. DCB is CR/PR, not duration-defined durable benefit. IP-MS enriched LKB1-interacting proteins in H1299/H292; it was neither a PD-L1 immunoprecipitation nor unbiased whole-proteome profiling, and peptide/protein counts conflict. Skp2 inhibition attenuated, rather than improved, anti-PD-L1 efficacy in mouse models. Main-table, lysine-site and implantation-route inconsistencies remain bounded.

records.title: Tumor-secreted AGR2 induces dendritic cell dysfunction and impairs immunotherapy efficacy in LKB1-deficient cancer

records.boundary: No original scRNA-seq; GSE180963 is a reanalysis of the dataset generated in PMID36512628 and is not an independent cohort. Panc02 is pancreatic, not lung. OVA/FLT3L/DC interventions are mouse and CB-1158 rescue is in vitro. Tumor/tdLN OT-I percentage readouts do not establish lower absolute OT-I counts. TCF1/TIM3 and ARG1-MFI figures contradict prose; affected direction-specific claims are withheld.

records.title: PARP Inhibition Induces Synthetic Lethality and Adaptive Immunity in LKB1-Mutant Lung Cancer
records.primary_classification: LKB1缺失-PARP1-STAT1 PARylation与PARP抑制联合免疫治疗
records.boundary: Mouse/cell preclinical results do not establish universal STK11 clinical synthetic lethality or HRD. Olaparib alone produced short-term control but nonsignificant OS; combination survival improved. Fig.1J is the CXCL10-transcript panel and Fig.1K-L test anti-PD-1 with or without fludarabine; CXCL10 add-back is only a main-text report pointing to unsupplied Supplementary Fig.S1Q. Likewise, KP/KPL GSE194166 is text-reported via unsupplied Fig.S1D-E, while Fig.7 is a mechanism schematic. No mapped STAT1 PARylation residue or body-weight/systemic-safety endpoint; dose/timing conflicts remain.

records.boundary: Single-arm; Figure 2 extreme-outcome subgroup denominators must not be treated as all-patient genotype response rates; STK11 OR 0.71 (0.25-2.02) is not equivalence or a predictive marker.

records.title: Comutations and KRASG12C Inhibitor Efficacy in Advanced NSCLC
records.primary_classification: pooled multicenter retrospective KRAS G12C inhibitor cohort
records.boundary: Coverage-specific denominators; KSC is alteration of any one of KEAP1/SMARCA4/CDKN2A, not a triple mutation, and the source includes deletions/amplifications/rearrangements as applicable. Figure6B prints 25.3% beside 19/76; 25.0% is only a derived arithmetic check, not a source correction. ATRX/DAXX OS combines a Cox CI crossing 1 with a significant log-rank P, and Figure4F shows WT n=107 in the legend versus 111 in the risk table. Preserve test identity and denominator conflicts. No randomized comparator separates prognosis from treatment prediction.

records.boundary: Model-specific immune-resistance mechanism; responses depend on the KPL-3M versus parental KPL-P background. No patient treatment-selection validation. G-MDSC percentages use CD45+ denominators; pooled samples are not independent biological replicates.

records.title: Proteogenomics of non-small cell lung cancer reveals molecular subtypes associated with specific therapeutic targets and immune evasion mechanisms
records.primary_classification: NSCLC蛋白基因组分型、STK11相关FGL1/CPS1表型及分类器验证
records.boundary: Proteome subtypes are not mutation diagnoses or validated clinical treatment predictors. Partial assay overlap and classifier-denominator attrition remain; NCP orthogonal review found 36/104 incorrect, without HLA-presentation or T-cell-recognition proof, and TCGA OS P=.216 is negative. The HNF1A methylation/protein correlation is R=-0.43, not -0.41. Preserve unresolved source conflicts for Fig.6E alpha- versus beta-tubulin, ED7D 1st/99th versus 5th/95th percentiles, and ED10I 5,123 versus 5,124 proteins. No operational biological methods retained.
